notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person_id as the primary key for the person table.
Data release cycle identifier; stored as an observation with observation_concept_id representing 'Data release number' (custom concept).
Interview/examination status; maps to observation. 1=Interviewed only, 2=Both. Use custom concept for status.
Six-month exam period; maps to observation. 1=Nov-Apr, 2=May-Oct. Custom concept for seasonality.
Gender: 1=Male (8507), 2=Female (8532). Direct mapping to OMOP gender concepts.
Age at screening; used to calculate year_of_birth by subtracting age from screening year. Topcoded at 80.
Age in months at screening; stored as observation for precise age. Custom concept for age in months.
Age in months at exam; stored as observation. Custom concept for exam age in months.

Race/Ethnicity recode; maps to ethnicity_concept_id. 1=Mexican American (Hispanic), 2=Other Hispanic, 3=Non-Hispanic White, 4=Non-Hispanic Black, 5=Other. Use OMOP ethnicity concepts (Hispanic/Not Hispanic) and race_concept_id separately.
Served in US Armed Forces; maps to observation. 1=Yes, 2=No. Custom concept for military service.
Country of birth recode; maps to observation. Custom concept for birth country category.
Citizenship status; maps to observation. 1=Citizen, 2=Not citizen. Custom concept.
Length of time in US; maps to observation. Ordinal categories. Custom concept.
Education level for children/youth 6-19; maps to observation. Custom concept for education level.
Education level for adults 20+; maps to observation. Custom concept for education level.
Currently attending school; maps to observation. 1=In school, 2=On vacation, 3=Neither. Custom concept.
Marital status; maps to observation. 1=Married, 2=Widowed, 3=Divorced, 4=Separated, 5=Never married. Custom concept.
Total number of people in household; maps to observation as numeric value. Custom concept for household size.
Total number of people in family; maps to observation as numeric value. Custom concept for family size.
Annual household income range; maps to observation. Custom concept for income bracket.
Annual family income range; maps to observation. Custom concept for income bracket.
Ratio of family income to poverty; maps to observation as continuous numeric value. Custom concept for income-to-poverty ratio.
Pregnancy status at exam; maps to observation. 1=Pregnant, 2=Not pregnant, 3=Cannot ascertain. Custom concept.
Household reference person gender; not mapped to person table (belongs to household reference person, not the sample person). Could be stored in observation if needed.
Household reference person age; not mapped to person table (belongs to household reference person). Could be stored in observation.
Household reference person country of birth; not mapped to person table. Could be stored in observation.
Household reference person education level; not mapped to person table. Could be stored in observation.
Household reference person marital status; not mapped to person table. Could be stored in observation.
Household reference person's spouse education level; not mapped to person table. Could be stored in observation.
Language of SP interview; maps to observation. 1=English, 2=Spanish. Custom concept for interview language.
Proxy used in SP interview; maps to observation. 1=Yes, 2=No. Custom concept.
Interpreter used in SP interview; maps to observation. 1=Yes, 2=No. Custom concept.
Language of family interview; maps to observation. 1=English, 2=Spanish. Custom concept.
Proxy used in family interview; maps to observation. 1=Yes, 2=No. Custom concept.
Interpreter used in family interview; maps to observation. 1=Yes, 2=No. Custom concept.
Language of MEC interview; maps to observation. 1=English, 2=Spanish. Custom concept.
Proxy used in MEC interview; maps to observation. 1=Yes, 2=No. Custom concept.
Interpreter used in MEC interview; maps to observation. 1=Yes, 2=No. Custom concept.
Language of ACASI interview; maps to observation. 1=English, 2=Spanish. Custom concept.
Full sample 2-year interview weight; maps to observation as numeric value. Custom concept for survey weight. Can also be stored in a custom survey_weight table.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight; maps to observation as numeric value. Custom concept for survey weight.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU; maps to observation as design variable. Custom concept for survey design.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum; maps to observation as design variable. Custom concept for survey design.
